posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Actually, the store shipping prices are calculated by a FedEx plug in based on our shipping rates. The store charges you what we pay for shipping and handling. 

That said, if you want something cheaper, we can usually do small things cheaply through USPS, but they take (much) longer and have no tracking information or shipping insurance. We try to keep our shipping rates are reasonable as possible, but ultimately, we're just charging what we're paying the shipping company to get the box to you.
